class ExpiryWarningTests(TestCase):
    def setUp(self):
        super().setUp()
        self.o = Organizer.objects.create(name='Dummy', slug='dummy')
        with scope(organizer=self.o):
            self.event = Event.objects.create(
                organizer=self.o, name='Dummy', slug='dummy',
                date_from=now() + timedelta(days=30),
                plugins='pretix.plugins.banktransfer,tests.testdummy'
            )
            self.event.settings.mail_days_order_expire_warning = 3
            self.order = self._create_order('FOO', expires=now() + timedelta(days=2))
            djmail.outbox = []

    def _create_order(self, code, **kwargs):
        defaults = dict(
            code=code, event=self.event, email='dummy@dummy.test',
            status=Order.STATUS_PENDING, locale='en',
            datetime=now() - timedelta(days=1),
            expires=now() + timedelta(days=10),
            total=Decimal('46.00'),
            sales_channel=self.event.organizer.sales_channels.get(identifier="web"),
        )
        defaults.update(kwargs)
        return Order.objects.create(**defaults)

    @classscope(attr='o')
    def test_sent_within_window(self):
        send_expiry_warnings(sender=self.event)
        assert len(djmail.outbox) == 1
        assert djmail.outbox[0].to == ['dummy@dummy.test']
        self.order.refresh_from_db()
        assert self.order.expiry_reminder_sent
        assert self.order.all_logentries().filter(action_type='pretix.event.order.email.expire_warning_sent').exists()

    @classscope(attr='o')
    def test_not_sent_outside_window(self):
        self.order.expires = now() + timedelta(days=4)
        self.order.save()
        send_expiry_warnings(sender=self.event)
        assert len(djmail.outbox) == 0
        self.order.refresh_from_db()
        assert not self.order.expiry_reminder_sent

    @classscope(attr='o')
    def test_disabled_if_zero_days(self):
        self.event.settings.mail_days_order_expire_warning = 0
        send_expiry_warnings(sender=self.event)
        assert len(djmail.outbox) == 0

    @classscope(attr='o')
    def test_sent_only_once(self):
        send_expiry_warnings(sender=self.event)
        send_expiry_warnings(sender=self.event)
        assert len(djmail.outbox) == 1

    @classscope(attr='o')
    def test_not_sent_for_paid_order(self):
        self.order.status = Order.STATUS_PAID
        self.order.save()
        send_expiry_warnings(sender=self.event)
        assert len(djmail.outbox) == 0

    @classscope(attr='o')
    def test_not_sent_for_expired_order(self):
        self.order.expires = now() - timedelta(hours=1)
        self.order.save()
        send_expiry_warnings(sender=self.event)
        assert len(djmail.outbox) == 0

    @classscope(attr='o')
    def test_not_sent_for_valid_if_pending_order(self):
        self.order.valid_if_pending = True
        self.order.save()
        send_expiry_warnings(sender=self.event)
        assert len(djmail.outbox) == 0

    @classscope(attr='o')
    def test_not_sent_for_order_requiring_approval(self):
        self.order.require_approval = True
        self.order.save()
        send_expiry_warnings(sender=self.event)
        assert len(djmail.outbox) == 0

    @classscope(attr='o')
    def test_not_sent_for_order_with_cancellation_fee(self):
        OrderFee.objects.create(
            order=self.order, fee_type=OrderFee.FEE_TYPE_CANCELLATION, value=Decimal('5.00'),
        )
        send_expiry_warnings(sender=self.event)
        assert len(djmail.outbox) == 0

    @classscope(attr='o')
    def test_each_order_uses_its_own_event_setting(self):
        other_event = Event.objects.create(
            organizer=self.o, name='Other', slug='other',
            date_from=now() + timedelta(days=30),
            plugins='pretix.plugins.banktransfer,tests.testdummy'
        )
        other_event.settings.mail_days_order_expire_warning = 0
        other_order = self._create_order('BAR', event=other_event, expires=now() + timedelta(days=2))

        send_expiry_warnings(sender=self.event)
        assert len(djmail.outbox) == 1
        other_order.refresh_from_db()
        assert not other_order.expiry_reminder_sent
EOF
